Keyboard users never hover, so a tooltip or a preview that only shows on hover does not exist for them. Focus is the keyboard's version of hover: pair `onMouseOver` with `onFocus`, and `onMouseOut` with `onBlur`.

Only HTML elements are checked, not components.

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"count": 2} */}
```jsx
const help = (
  <button onMouseOver={showTooltip} onMouseOut={hideTooltip}>
    Help
  </button>
);
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```jsx
const help = (
  <button
    onMouseOver={showTooltip}
    onFocus={showTooltip}
    onMouseOut={hideTooltip}
    onBlur={hideTooltip}
  >
    Help
  </button>
);
```

## Options

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hoverInHandlers` | `["onMouseOver"]` | Handlers that need an `onFocus` next to them. |
| `hoverOutHandlers` | `["onMouseOut"]` | Handlers that need an `onBlur` next to them. |

Your list replaces the default. `onMouseEnter` is not checked unless you add it:

{/* good */}
```jsx
const card = <div onMouseEnter={showPreview} />;
```

{/* bad {"options": [{"hoverInHandlers": ["onMouseOver", "onMouseEnter"]}]} */}
```jsx
const card = <div onMouseEnter={showPreview} />;
```
